simple.meaning: בָּשַׁס (bâshaç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to trample down.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Amos, beginning at Amos 5:11. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּשַׁס (H1318) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בָּשַׁס (bâshaç) / H1318 is traced through Amos 5:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H1318. bashas [ בשׁס ] verb Po`el Infinitive suffix בּוֺשַׁסְכֶם Amos 5:11 probably your trampling (by dissimilation from בּוּס ) followed by עַל . בּשֶׁת see below בושׁ .
